action_items.text: Complete a questionnaire and a summary individually after the meeting.
Ensure the minutes and project documentation, including PowerPoint slides, are accessible for everyone.
Note any frustrations or issues in your summary.
Industrial Design: Complete the components concept.
User Interface: Complete the user interface concept.
Check the group folder for shared project documents and ensure your files are correctly placed.

decisions.text: The group will follow the order of presentations as initially suggested by A (D, then C, then B).
The group agreed to focus on the remote control's appearance (fashion appeal) and usability (ease of use, fewer buttons, addressing repetitive strain injury) based on market research findings.
The group decided not to work with teletext as it has been largely replaced by the internet.
Management has decided not to work with Ceefax-like technology for the remote.
Focus on designing the remote for television only, not for other devices like video or electronics.
Use the company’s corporate image, including the yellow color and the slogan, in the new remote design.
Target group is narrowed down to under sixty-five years old, focusing on simplicity and fashion.
Remote will be sold separately from the television for €25.
Voice recognition will not be included in the remote due to cost and complexity.
Remote should have large, accessible buttons for essential functions.
Remote should include a feature to help locate it if lost (e.g., a beep or ring function).
Remote should have a possibility to access extra functions, which can be hidden or less prominent.
Remote should be fashionable and aesthetically pleasing.
Consider using a rechargeable battery or a charging station instead of disposable batteries.
Emphasize simplicity and ease of use, including functional infrared capabilities.
Focus on simplicity and fashion as core design goals.
